popCulture.title: 29 Amphitrite
popCulture.description: A large main-belt asteroid took Poseidon's queen's name — Amphitrite among the rocks between Mars and Jupiter.

popCulture.title: Amphitrite
popCulture.description: Amphitrite survives as the poetic name for the sea's calm sovereignty — Poseidon's consort who stills the waves she rules.
